messages:
Alex: Quick pulse on the continuous-batching sprint — canary run is live on 6 nodes, seeing ~12% p99 token reduction but CPU climb on batch controller. anyone owning KV warmup?
Priya: I own KV warmup. ETA EOD tomorrow to land the prefetch fix. opened PR #487 (small locking tweak). need marc for review.
Marc: On review list. saw one potential deadlock if queue.empty() and pop races — will post inline comments. aiming to finish review by 11:30 PT.
Tina: Infra note: canary-3 OOMed at 10:12, I rolled back batch_size_growth to 1.1 to stabilize. watching memory.
Alex: Does that rollback break our latency SLOs for the canary?
Tina: Median latency up ~3ms, p99 roughly flat. tradeoff OK for now.
Josh: Suggestion: skip kv-prefetch for short sequences (seq_len < 32) — big memory win. have branch opt/small-seq-skip with microbenchmark.
Priya: Good call. I'll run our regressions with that flag. if green, can patch into canary.
Marc: Added two review comments on PR #487: 1) prefer explicit lock scope, 2) add a deterministic seed in the unit test to reduce flakiness.
Alex: Ownership after merge — who will re-run canary and validate?
Tina: I can take the rollout step. will coordinate image bump with infra team.
Alex: Any infra dependencies or tickets we need?
Tina: Need kernel image bump to 2.10.3. filed INF-2247 and pinged infra for approval.
infra-bot: Image rollout request submitted to infra-team (INF-2247). ETA ~24h.
Priya: Blocking item: kv_warmup_test is flaky on A100. repro cmd: 
```
pytest tests/test_kv_warmup.py::test_prefetch_stress -k a100
```
stacktrace points at prefetch queue race.
Marc: I'll try to reproduce on my A100 rig now. if I can reproduce, I'll add deterministic seeds and a targeted regression test.
Josh: Also pushed telemetry change: gauge prefetch_queue_length in PR #502. please merge so we get granular metrics during canary.
Alex: Cool. Next steps: 1) Marc finish review + merge #487, 2) Priya validate short-seq skip, 3) Tina coordinate image bump + run canary post-merge, 4) Josh merge telemetry PR. Async updates here by EOD. If anything urgent ping @here. :thumbsup:
